_comment: Example Jira board config. Symphony needs a distinct Jira status per Symphony state — otherwise the poller fetches the same issue into multiple buckets. Replace the `transitions` placeholders with the real numeric transition IDs from `curl -u email:token https://<site>.atlassian.net/rest/api/2/issue/<KEY>/transitions`.
name: UP
_assigneeIdComment: Jira accountId of the user who owns this board — overrides symphony.json.assigneeId.
